summary.headline: Zodiacal Signs and Astrological Portents
summary.text: Catalog of Florentine codex folios covering the countries ruled by the twelve zodiac signs, stellar significations and rulerships, eclipses, solar and lunar portents, horoscopes, climacteric years, universal beginnings, and planetary phases with the Sun. Cites Ptolemy, Hephaestus Thebanus, Heliodorus, Maximus, and Paulus Alexandrinus, with editions by Wachsmuth, Ludwich, and Olivieri.
